slots.root: fixed inset-0 z-palette flex items-start justify-center pt-[12vh] bg-scrim backdrop-blur-scrim
slots.panel: flex flex-col max-h-[88vh] w-140 max-w-[92vw] bg-surface-floating border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-edge-surface-floating rounded-surface shadow-surface-deep overflow-hidden
slots.search: flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-3.5 border-b-[length:var(--bw-separator)] border-[color:var(--fields-neutral-field-edge-rest,var(--edge-field))]
slots.esc: font-face-key text-ctl-xs case-key text-ink-key/(--level-ink-muted) border-[length:var(--bw-marker)] border-edge-control-quiet rounded-marker px-marker-x py-key-y
slots.groupLabel: px-row-x pt-[calc(var(--sp-1)*3*var(--dz-row-scale-y))] pb-[calc(var(--sp-1)*1.5*var(--dz-row-scale-y))] font-face-label text-label font-bold tracking-label-role case-label text-ink-muted/(--level-ink-muted)
slots.row: flex items-center gap-row w-full min-h-ctl-h text-left px-row-x py-row-y rounded-control border-none cursor-pointer no-underline shadow-control-rest active:scale-[var(--press-scale)] motion-reduce:active:scale-100 bg-[color:var(--menus-plain-item-fill-rest,transparent)] [--arena-icon-ink:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--menus-plain-item-icon-rest,var(--menus-plain-item-ink-rest,var(--ink-body)))_var(--level-ink-body),transparent)] text-[color:color-mix(in_oklab,var(--menus-plain-item-ink-rest,var(--ink-body))_var(--level-ink-body),transparent)]

floating.root: a palette floats over the page, so the region it was opened from does not decide its rows

internal.active: the row the keyboard cursor is on
